title: Almora: Crafting Desire in Business
summary: Kahran and Divya walk slide-by-slide through the investor deck for Almora Botanica, a luxury Ayurvedic skincare brand built by ex-Himalaya MD Ravi Prasad. They unpack how brand image, copy, font choice, and information density create or break emotional connection — and what a deck does when it gets correct but loses the reader's gut.

intents.display: to hear a deck and a brand torn apart slide by slide
to think about emotional connection vs cognitive load in brand copy
